column2: iii.     When  preparing,  serving, and  consuming  food  on  the premises, no  person  shall  clean  the  floor  of  the

column1: room by any means other than dust-free floor cleaning.

column2: iv.    All  equipment used  in  serving  or  consuming  food  shall  be  cleaned  of  sufficient  quantities  of  the  food
stored  therein,  washed  with  warm  soapy  water  or  other  washing  water  with  sufficient  soap  and  other

column1: washing water, and then sanitized by the Licensee of the Company. Must be dealt with.

column2: v.      Adequate  precautionary  measures  should  be  taken  to  prevent  contamination  of  food  by  water,  rinse,
disinfectants and fluids, by cleaning equipment or tools, and by disinfection. If there are any residues on

column1: the surface that touch the food, wash it several times with drinking water.
